description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: Super Productivity is an advanced todo list app with integrated Timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. It also comes with integrations for Jira, GitLab, GitHub and Open Project.
Discover the best native macOS apps: fast, lightweight Mac apps for productivity, developer tools, and everyday utilities. Free and paid options. No Electron.

NEO Emacs (WIP): GPU powered Emacs written in Rust with a modern display engine. Aiming for modern design & multi-threaded Elisp, 10x performance, zero-pause concurrent GC and 100% Emacs compatibility.
🎙️ AI Dictation App - Open Source and Local-first ⚡ Type 3x faster, no keyboard needed. 🆓 Powered by open source models, works offline, fast and accurate.
Kition brings Markdown, DataTable, WhiteBoard, a tool-using AI agent, browser research, and visual workflows into one desktop workspace.

🐦 Native menu bar & tray app for macOS, Windows and Linux: track Codex, Claude Code and Grok quotas, resets, API-equivalent cost and local sessions, with multi-account and API relay switching | 原生 macOS、Windows、Linux 菜单栏与托盘应用，统一查看 Codex、Claude Code、Grok 额度、重置动态、API 等价成本与本机会话，支持多账号与中转 API 切换

Termul is Terminal Ultimate Manager a cross-platform desktop terminal manager built with Tauri and React. Organize terminals by workspace with persistent sessions, multiple shell, split panes, embedded browser tabs, and a built-in code & markdown editor.
Tiling that feels like it shipped with macOS. Works out of the Box, settings menu, in-app updates, native Desktops kept intact, Lua underneath. Accessibility only, never SIP.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
The control plane for your AI employees

Your work, already underway. A personal AI assistant for your job: mail, chats and tickets become tasks, the agents you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Open source, runs on your machine.

Open-source Arc-style browser built on Chromium: sidebar with vertical tabs, Spaces, folders, pinned tabs, a command bar, one-click import from Arc. macOS and Windows (Linux is coming soon). No telemetry.
Break the doomscroll habit with a quick math challenge. The more you scroll, the harder it gets. Step away and it gets easier. Open source, no ads, no tracking, works offline.
